scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:local: printf 'y\n' | wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: printf 'y\n' | wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Stored as a Worker secret.

BOT_ADMIN_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated Telegram numeric user IDs with access to the private bot-owner panel, group allowlist, and bot settings. Leave empty to require Telegram group-admin status for group settings.

BOT_READ_ALL_GROUP_MESSAGES.description: Optional true/false setting applied during webhook setup. true disables Telegram Privacy Mode to receive ordinary group messages; false enables it; empty preserves the current Telegram setting.

Optional true/false setting applied through Telegram setMySettings. true disables Privacy Mode so the bot can receive ordinary group messages; false enables Privacy Mode; empty preserves the Telegram setting.
